Lisa · Listen & Shadow 04

The First Contact — the email, the call, saying it better
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE EMAIL
👤 The Winery
This is the first email. Who are you, in two sentences?
처음 보내는 메일이에요. 본인 소개 두 문장으로.
in two sentences — 두 문장으로
💬 Lisa
I'm reaching out because we're looking for Burgundy in the Korean market.
저희가 한국에서 부르고뉴 와인을 찾고 있어서 연락드립니다.
reach out — 연락하다 · look for ~ — ~를 찾다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm reaching out because a colleague mentioned you. · I'm reaching out about your 2022 vintage.
💬 Lisa
We've been following your domaine for a few years now.
몇 년 전부터 도멘을 눈여겨보고 있었습니다.
follow — 관심 있게 지켜보다 · domaine — (프랑스) 와이너리
같은 패턴으로 — We've been following your work since 2020. · I've been following that producer for a while.
💬 Lisa
Specifically, we'd like to request a few samples and a call.
구체적으로는 샘플 몇 병과 통화를 요청드리고 싶습니다.
specifically — 구체적으로 · request — 요청하다
같은 패턴으로 — Specifically, we'd like to see the 2023. · Specifically, I'd like to understand your allocation.
💬 Lisa
Would you be open to a call sometime in September?
9월에 한번 통화 가능하실까요?
be open to ~ — ~에 열려 있다
같은 패턴으로 — Would you be open to a visit? · Would you be open to a smaller order to start?
PART 2 · THE CALL
👤 The Winery
What volume are you thinking?
물량은 어느 정도 생각하세요?
volume — 물량
💬 Lisa
We'd start with a small volume and see how it goes.
우선 소량으로 시작해서 상황을 보려고 합니다.
see how it goes — 어떻게 되는지 보다
같은 패턴으로 — We'd start with one label and see how it goes. · Let's start small and see.
👤 The Winery
Who else do you carry?
다른 어떤 브랜드를 취급하세요?
carry — 취급하다
💬 Lisa
Alongside Burgundy, we carry New Zealand and Italy.
부르고뉴 외에도 뉴질랜드와 이탈리아를 취급하고 있습니다.
alongside ~ — ~와 함께
같은 패턴으로 — Alongside the reds, we carry a few whites. · Alongside my main job, I teach.
👤 The Winery
We're fully allocated for this year.
올해 물량은 이미 다 배정됐어요.
fully allocated — 물량이 다 배정된
💬 Lisa
If allocation is tight, would next year's vintage work?
물량이 빠듯하면, 내년 빈티지 예약은 어떨까요?
tight — 빠듯한 · vintage — 빈티지, 생산 연도
같은 패턴으로 — If the date is tight, would Friday work? · If the budget is tight, would a smaller size work?
💬 Lisa
Let me consult with my team and come back to you.
본사와 상의하고 다시 연락드리겠습니다.
consult with ~ — ~와 상의하다 · come back to you — 다시 연락드리다
같은 패턴으로 — Let me check with the buyer and come back to you. · Let me think about it and come back to you.
PART 3 · SAY IT BETTER
👤 The Winery
Same thing, higher gear.
같은 말을 격을 올려서 해볼까요?
higher gear — 한 단계 위로
💬 Lisa
We're looking to bring in two of your labels.
저희는 두 가지 라벨을 들여오려고 합니다.
be looking to ~ — ~하려고 하다 (we want보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — We're looking to expand our Italian range. · They're looking to open a second store.
💬 Lisa
Would it be possible to send a few samples?
샘플을 보내주실 수 있을까요?
Would it be possible to ~? — ~해주실 수 있을까요? (can you send보다 정중함)
같은 패턴으로 — Would it be possible to move the meeting? · Would it be possible to see the cellar?
💬 Lisa
There's strong demand for Burgundy in Korea.
한국에서 부르고뉴 수요가 강합니다.
demand — 수요 (it's popular보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — There's strong demand for natural wine. · Demand has been steady all year.
💬 Lisa
It's one of our stronger lines.
저희 주력 품목 중 하나예요.
line — 취급 품목 (we sell a lot보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — It's one of our stronger regions. · That's our strongest month.
💬 Lisa
It would be a natural fit for our portfolio.
저희 포트폴리오에 자연스럽게 맞습니다.
a natural fit — 잘 어울리는 것 (we really want it 대신)
같은 패턴으로 — She'd be a natural fit for that team. · It's a natural fit for the season.
녹음 18/18
